interpretation.body_support_is_real: Actual nominal native torso force and sensor calibration confirm meaningful support; signed distance tolerance alone cannot rule it out.
interpretation.static_reference: Initial intended stance has10.32mm torso clearance. Under fixed5.5/.25 PD at nominal class-driver limits it settles with~9.48N torso load in the1hull model, so feasible kinematics do not imply maintained dynamic clearance.
interpretation.native_baseline_stop: Sampled torso normal load averages8.52N in final stop (~27% bodyweight) and exceeds10% bodyweight for83.7% of stage, longest1.65s sampled run. Moving contacts are shorter bursts and coexist with planar base motion.
interpretation.gpu_geometry: All5 policies intermittently penetrate; >0.1mm threshold misses static support below that tolerance.
interpretation.force_smoke: Actual baseline actor2world CPU nominal1hull idle load~67% bodyweight; randomized2world smoke~79%. These are small diagnostic examples, not a statistically established DR effect.

limits: Native has9hulls/520Hz, GPU has1hull/250Hz; contact model and rate effects are not isolated by cross-model comparison.
Native loads are sampled52Hz, not fully integrated impulses; force/pose alignment differs by at most1/520s.
Planar base speed under load is a sliding proxy, not reconstructed contact-point slip.
